name: arrow-fill-button
title: Arrow Fill Button
description: Button with expanding circle fill and animated arrow icon on hover

changelog.summary: Added prefers-reduced-motion support: fill/clip-path/arrow hover transitions are disabled or shown in their end state instead of animating

props.name: fillTextColor
props.description: Label color inside the fill before hover.

props.name: hoverFillTextColor
props.description: Label color inside the expanded fill on hover.

props.name: arrowColor
props.description: Arrow color before hover. Falls back to fillTextColor when unset.

props.name: hoverArrowColor
props.description: Arrow color after hover. Falls back to hoverFillTextColor when unset.
